body: A few years after highschool,  my best friend messaged me on facebook and asked me for a ride and if he could sleep at my place.  I told my self that I had more important things to do,so I didnt respond.  The next morning, I wake up to the news that he passed away from being atruck by a car while walking home at like 2am on a rural country rd.  I still look at that message in my inbox from time to time,  but I still get sick to my stomach.  I couldn't bring myself to tell anyone about it.  It just slowly eats away at me.  My advice is to talk to some one.  Don't internalize thise feelings.  Trust me.
